1169-4316-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3169-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3169-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2843-3175-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2167-7893.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2167-7893.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-2167-7893.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Squandered Resources ability
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

301-2813-4535.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2813-4535.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

1263-2921-4871-7316.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1008-3457-7791.description:
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Undermountain Adventurer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Undermountain Adventurer.
Repeat.

1308-4871-6705.description:
Activate Quina by paying {2} and sacrificing a Frog.
When the Frog dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens due to Quina and Anointed Procession.
Resolve the Quina ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

575-5971-6505.easyPrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-5971-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Yedora triggers, returning Spore Frog from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Spore Frog enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spore Frog by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Spore Frog face-up.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability from step 1.
Repeat.

423-433-1362-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-1362-1437--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering Evolution Sage.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-3743-4365-5089-7435.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4365-5089-7435.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2034-7084-7396.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2919-4050-4365-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4050-4365-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

4038-5704-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Leafkin Avenger's ability by tapping it, adding {G} for each creature you control with power 4 or greater.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.
4038-5704-5963.notes: The {2} is only required if you don't control another creature with power 4 or greater.

225-539-3573-6844.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
225-539-3573-6844.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Repeat.
225-539-3573-6844.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

2757-3209-5094-6984.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control at least six creatures.
2757-3209-5094-6984.description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least six {G}
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling, untapping Evendo, Waking Haven.
Repeat.

3490-4785-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4785-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

101-1987-3227-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1987-3227-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Scrivener and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-3227-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2781-6406-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {1} and tapping Appa.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0} and tapping Appa and the Ally token.
Repeat from step 4.
2781-6406-6867.notes: If you control another creature, you can reduce the cost by {1} and tap that creature in step 3 instead of paying mana.

2267-2558-5226--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2267-2558-5226--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Tormod triggers. Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

359-813-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Acrobatic Maneuver.
359-813-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

586-5256-5258-5618-5687.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1069-2079-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-2079-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

3490-4050-4505.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3490-4050-4505.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an additional creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Feral Ghoul's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Feral Ghoul, you may sacrifice it to give opponents infinite rad counters, which will cause them to mill their library and lose a large amount of life during their next precombat main phase.
